title: 2 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 18
description: Ten questions on 2 Samuel 18: the battle in the forest of Ephraim, the death of Absalom, and David's grief.

questions.text: Who led the third part of David's people besides Joab and Abishai?
questions.explanation: David sent a third part under Joab, a third part under Abishai, and a third part under Ittai the Gittite.

questions.text: How much did the people say David was worth?
questions.explanation: The people said, "You are worth ten thousand of us."

questions.text: What did the king command Joab, Abishai and Ittai concerning Absalom?
questions.explanation: The king said, "Deal gently for my sake with the young man, even with Absalom."

answers.text: Bring him back to the king in chains
Deal gently with him for the king's sake
Kill him wherever they find him
Drive him out of the land of Israel

questions.explanation: The people went out into the field against Israel, and the battle was in the forest of Ephraim.

questions.text: What happened when Absalom's mule went under the thick boughs of a great oak?
questions.explanation: His head caught hold of the oak, and he was taken up between the sky and earth.

answers.text: His robe caught on a thorn bush
His head caught hold of the oak
His foot caught in the stirrup
His sword caught in the branches

questions.text: What did Joab thrust through Absalom's heart?
questions.explanation: Joab took three darts in his hand and thrust them through the heart of Absalom.

questions.text: Why had Absalom set up a pillar in the king's valley?
questions.explanation: He said, "I have no son to keep my name in memory," and called the pillar after his own name.

answers.text: To mark the place of a victory
He had no son to keep his name in memory

questions.text: Where was David sitting while he waited for news?
questions.explanation: David was sitting between the two gates, while the watchman went up to the roof of the gate.

answers.text: In the room over the gate
At the fords of the wilderness

questions.explanation: Ahimaaz ran by the way of the Plain, and outran the Cushite.

questions.text: What did the king say as he went up to the room over the gate?
questions.explanation: He said, "My son Absalom! My son, my son Absalom! I wish I had died for you, Absalom, my son, my son!"

answers.text: "Yahweh has given and Yahweh has taken"
"I wish I had died for you"
"Bring me the man who killed him"
